newsitem.title: ISRAEL: France's Leclerc seeks to enter Israeli market.
newsitem.headline: France's Leclerc seeks to enter Israeli market.

text.p: French food retailer Leclerc is interested in setting up a supermarket network and increasing purchases in Israel, Federation of Israeli Chambers of Commerce president Dan Gillerman said on Sunday.
Gillerman and Leclerc chairman Michael Leclerc met in Tel Aviv along with leading Israeli retailers.
Gillerman welcomed the initiative and said Leclerc's entry into Israel would be an important addition to the number of international companies now operating in the Jewish state.

The privately owned Leclerc has 15.2 percent of France's retail food market. It owns 550 food outlets and employs more than 65,000 people. The company recently started operating in Spain and Portugal as well.
Israel's retail food market is dominated by Super Sol Ltd, Blue Square Israel Ltd and Shekem Ltd.
